title: Grade Factory runs and track improvement over time
prompt:
Extend the goal self-improvement loop in prototypes/software-factory/shared/goal.ts and prototypes/software-factory/coordinator/src/{goals,run,main}.ts to grade completed runs from plain prompts and saved goals, retaining evidence-backed history. Treat missing evidence as unknown rather than failure, and distinguish grading errors from failed grades. Compare external grading approaches in prototypes/software-factory/README.md. Extend prototypes/software-factory/web-foldkit/src/goals/{domain,view}.ts to show grade changes over time. Connect failed-grade proposals to Factory improvement work through an explicit approval and retry policy.

Inputs:
- AGENTS.md
- prototypes/software-factory/README.md
- prototypes/software-factory/shared/goal.ts
- prototypes/software-factory/coordinator/goal-cli.ts
- prototypes/software-factory/coordinator/src/goals.ts
- prototypes/software-factory/coordinator/src/run.ts
- prototypes/software-factory/coordinator/src/main.ts
- prototypes/software-factory/coordinator/test/run.test.ts
- prototypes/software-factory/skills/factory-loop/SKILL.md
- prototypes/software-factory/web-foldkit/AGENTS.md
- prototypes/software-factory/web-foldkit/src/goals/domain.ts
- prototypes/software-factory/web-foldkit/src/goals/view.ts
- scripts/quality_prototypes.py
- .github/workflows/ci.yml

Constraints:
- Extend the goal types in prototypes/software-factory/shared/goal.ts, the existing coordinator run records and completion path, and the existing Foldkit Goals UI; do not introduce a separate goal store, grading service or dashboard.
- Keep existing goal specs and run logs readable.
- Keep PR merging under human control.
- Use Foldkit; do not add React or CopilotKit.
- Use fixture-based tests without live model calls or paid quota.
- Keep objective results and model-judged quality scores separate, with evidence and judge identity recorded.
- Each source run may trigger at most one improvement attempt, and improvement runs cannot recursively trigger another attempt.

Acceptance criteria (locked: use them as AC-1..AC-6 word for word in sdlc_plan; you may add criteria, never change or drop these):
AC-1: After a full Factory run from either a plain prompt or a saved goal ends, inspection of persisted records shows one grade linked to its thread, Factory commit, grading version and supporting evidence.
AC-2: Inspection of prototypes/software-factory/README.md shows a grading-method comparison citing at least three external Factory or agent-evaluation projects, with metric definitions, limitations and the chosen rubric.
AC-3: Each grade reports acceptance-criterion pass rate (passed / evaluated criteria), PR-check status and fixed-benchmark regression results separately. The grade fails if any evaluated criterion fails, any PR check fails or any benchmark regresses against its fixed baseline; otherwise it is unknown if required evidence is missing, and passes only when all required results pass. Grader execution errors are recorded as grading errors, not failed grades; model-judged quality scores do not affect this status.
AC-4: A failed grade creates an improvement proposal, and a fixture test proves no improvement run starts before human approval.
AC-5: The Foldkit Goals UI charts grades over time grouped by goal and grading version, without combining incompatible groups.
AC-6: Fixture tests in prototypes/software-factory/coordinator/test/run.test.ts verify that replaying a run-completion event does not create a duplicate grade.

Required checks:
- make factory-test
- uv run --offline --no-project python scripts/quality_prototypes.py web-foldkit
- mise run quality:static
- make publication-policy quality-contract
- make factory-test runs fixture tests proving that feedback cannot launch improvement work without recorded human approval and cannot retry beyond the configured limit.

bodyIncludes: AC-3: grade status, missing-evidence and grader-error fixtures PASS
AC-4: approval, one-attempt limit and recursion-blocking fixtures PASS
AC-6: completion replay creates no duplicate grade PASS
